dataset_description: 600 algorithm-blind synthetic source-anchored queries; 12 strata: 2 directions x 6 operations, 50 cases each
primary_outcome: Paired difference in source Hit@5, full 600-case equal-stratum mixture
primary_interval: Stratified percentile bootstrap 95% CI: 10000 resamples, resample 50 cases with replacement within each of 12 strata, deterministic seed TOULOUR-FINAL-ANALYSIS-20261019-R01
primary_significance: Two-sided exact McNemar test on discordant paired source Hit@5 outcomes, report p and discordant counts
secondary_outcomes: group results by direction and operation
latency_protocol: 3 measured repetitions after 1 warmup per scenario-query, rotated scenario order by case, report environment and internal timing limitations
constraints: Report all 600 cases and all six methods
Do not compute relevance precision, recall, F1, or verified no-match rates from source anchors
Source miss does not imply returned non-anchor entries are irrelevant
Synthetic stratified design is not an estimate of real-user query mixture
decision_rule: Report primary effect size, CI and p value, practical latency tradeoff, and limits; do not call method best unless supported by independent relevant comparisons.
